input.summary: Add an express Company convenience termination right on 90 days' notice, limit HDI's termination to the end of the then-current term, and cap the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have made our exit explicit — the Company may terminate for convenience on ninety (90) days' notice effective on the date specified in its notice — and limited HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term. We have also capped the Termination Payment at three months of Section 3 fees, consistent with our fallback position on early-termination fees.

ops.oldText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, but in no event more than three (3) months of fees payable under Section 3.

ops.text: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon ninety (90) days' written notice to HDI, effective on the date specified in that notice. Any termination by HDI under this Section 4.1 shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term.
